text:
Ari Chen: Quick sync — sprint planning for SDK + sample apps is Monday. We need to lock owners, launch criteria, and what we cut if scope slips.
Leah Kim: A few asks from support: smaller quickstarts for embedding + a short streaming TS example. We should prioritize docs parity.
Victor Ramos: +1 on streaming TS example. Also customers keep asking about 'cold start' perf; can we add a tiny benchmark sample?
Nina Patel: For ownership — I can take the sample app wiring (CI, infra, deploy templates) but need someone on API surface and docs. @Leah you ok to own docs?
Leah Kim: I can own docs and quickstarts but will need a tech review from eng runtime for the `streaming` API behavior.
Ari Chen: Solid. So current split: Nina = infra + sample infra templates, Leah = docs + quickstarts, Victor = code examples + perf bench. I'll own rollout/launch criteria and can shepherd.
Victor Ramos: Launch criteria proposal: 1) CI green on sample repo; 2) example passes perf smoke (latency <= 300ms median for 128 tokens on hosted dev cluster); 3) docs + code samples reviewed; 4) 1 internal demo. Thoughts?
Leah Kim: Add: 5) A short 'how it works' section explaining batching/kv cache implications for the example (one paragraph). Customers keep hitting that blind spot.
Nina Patel: And 6) deploy templates include KMS toggles for Private customers. We should mark that as optional for first release but documented.
Ari Chen: Good. Prioritization: we have capacity for 3 stories this sprint. Must-pick = streaming TS quickstart, CI infra templates, docs outline. Bench/perf can be opt-in next sprint unless Victor needs it now.
Victor Ramos: If bench is deprioritized, I still want a micro-benchmark harness checked in so we can run it later. I'll add a small script `bench/run_smoke.sh`.
Leah Kim: Can we define success metrics in OKR terms? Suggest: "DX-1 Increase sample-to-first-call time < 10min" and "DX-2 80% of trial devs complete quickstart without docs questions in 1st run" — measurable?
Ari Chen: Those are good. Make them actionable: DX-1 measured by telemetry funnel (signup->create API key->first request) and DX-2 by support ticket triage + in-person testing.
devex-bot: backlog summary: 7 open sample app issues, 3 PRs draft, 2 infra tickets. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-samples/labels/triage
Nina Patel: Scope negotiation note: the customer-requested multi-model routing sample is more involved (needs router + snapshot). Recommend we schedule as a follow-up milestone. Mark it as "post-launch".
Leah Kim: Agree. We should publish a short "coming soon" blurb in the quickstart to set expectations for multi-model support.
Ari Chen: Action items: (1) Leah: write docs outline + 2 quickstarts (streaming TS, embedding quickstart) — due Thu EOD (2) Nina: infra templates + CI skeleton — due Fri EOD (3) Victor: example code + bench harness PR — due next Wed (4) Ari: finalize launch checklist and run demo — due next Thu.
Victor Ramos: I'll open GH issues and link the PRs to OKR DX-1 and DX-2. GH refs: #487, #488, #489.
Leah Kim: Will draft the docs in `/docs/quickstarts/devex-samples` and add a short FAQ for batching tradeoffs.
Nina Patel: CI note — let's use ephemeral test tokens and a small infra budget; I'll add a `deploy-preview` job to avoid spending prod tokens.
Ari Chen: Risk list: 1) runtime API change could break streaming example — mitigation: add compatibility test; 2) infra quota delays — mitigation: run local mock fallback. Add to checklist.
Leah Kim: For compatibility test add something like: ```
# tests/compat/streaming_smoke.py
resp = client.stream("hello")
assert resp.startswith("Hello")
```
Victor Ramos: Nice. Also include a test that asserts response time < 500ms for CI non-blocking (report only).
Ari Chen: Last: communicate plan to PMs and support tonight. I'll post summary in #product and #support after this meeting. Anything else?
Leah Kim: Can we add a tiny user study plan? 3 devs to run quickstarts and record time-to-first-success. I can coordinate.
Nina Patel: I can provision the test accounts.
Victor Ramos: Cool. I'll start the PRs.
Ari Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap board and move items to 'sprint-next'. :rocket:
